Requirements of Indonesian law

In Indonesia, online safety and the protection of children in digital environments are regulated under national laws and regulations, including the Government Regulation No. 17 of 2025 on Governance of The Organization of Electronic Systems in Child Protection (“PP Tunas”) and its implementing regulation, Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs Regulation No. 9 of 2026 on Implementing Regulation of Government Regulation No. 17 of 2025 on Governance of The Organization of Electronic Systems in Child Protection (“MCDA 9/2026”).
Minimum age to use an >x< account in Indonesia

Starting 28 March 2026, you must be at least 16 years old to use an >x< account in Indonesia. This change is required by Indonesian law (namely PP Tunas and MCDA 9/2026) to introduce a social media minimum age (“SMMA”). The SMMA prevents age-restricted social media platforms, including >x<, from letting people under 16 create or keep an account. It’s not our choice - it’s what Indonesian law requires.

Important Note: >x< prioritizes your privacy. Your information is stored securely with strong protections in place. For further details on our data retention practices and privacy policies, please refer to our privacy center
What happens if we determine you are under 16
If signals indicate that a user is under 16, the user won't be able to use an >x< account until they are 16 or over and receive a notice to verify their age.

If you believe your account was incorrectly locked out, or if you wish to reinstate your account once you are 16 or over, you can follow the instructions to verify your age within the account lockout notice.
